Key-rate risk is concentrated at 10y (697 per bp, 85% of the total). Against the curve the bond trades at a z-spread of +193.5bp (curve price 117.344). Over a 3m horizon carry is +0.474 and roll-down -0.181 per 100, +0.294 in total, so yields can rise 3.7bp before the position loses money. Funding uses price * (1 / DF(h) - 1), with h capped at maturity: a curve-based funding proxy, not an executable repo quote.
